must never push. Never write to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow.

write your report at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/<that path>.

codes, the files you touched (scratch only), what you found, what you could not
evaluate, and your limits. An unrun check has not passed: never report a command you
did not run, and never quote an output you did not observe.

# Leaf discipline
Leaf by default: do not delegate, do not spawn background jobs, do not use `ask`, never
message `agent://all`. One executor seat may spawn exactly one read-only `labrat`
probe for a falsifiable hypothesis (host depth limit 3); nothing else spawns.

Any agent may install or update a tool that helps its task without asking. Read
/home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first and follow it (official sources, update-safety
gate, installation record with tool/version/channel/reason). PACMAN IS PAUSED HOST-WIDE:

/home/vgpnk/.local/bin, or file an L0 question instead. When the pause lifts, the

if every listed package is not installed yet; never `-Sy`, `-Syu`, `-U`, `-R`, a
downgrade, or a host-service restart.

# Honesty
Report what you observed, including dead ends, null results and limits. Do not
fabricate evidence, do not soften a finding into a pass, and do not edit another
seat's report. If a surface is unreachable, say so with the exact error text.

# Routing
Do not supply a model and do not name a provider; the host route table binds each
taxonomy role to its own bucket. The L1 records the answering model when a claim
depends on it.
